name: Slider / AI Creativity
description: AI Creativity product scenario for the Slider component.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Controlled value: a number, or one number per thumb; callbacks answer in the same shape. Shown snapped, clamped and sorted.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Value on mount, restored by form reset; a number or an array, as for value. Defaults to min.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Dynamic errors are mirrored to a polite live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: min
controls.description: Lower end of the scale and origin of the step grid; crossed or non-finite bounds use 0..100. Defaults to 0.

controls.name: max
controls.description: Upper end of the scale; crossed or non-finite bounds use 0..100. Defaults to 100.

controls.name: step
controls.description: Distance between selectable values; End selects the last step at or below max. Defaults to 1.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Blocks editing, crop included, and leaves every control out of FormData.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Horizontal follows the text direction; vertical increases upward. Defaults to horizontal.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the group and its thumbs when there is no visible label.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of elements that name the group and its thumbs; they take precedence over label and aria-label.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Complete accessible names for individual thumbs and crop boundaries.

controls.name: showValue
controls.description: Shows each primary value inside its thumb.

controls.name: crop
controls.description: Adds two crop boundaries on a second rail, edited independently of the value.

controls.name: cropRange
controls.description: Controlled crop boundaries; undefined leaves them uncontrolled.

controls.name: defaultCropRange
controls.description: Crop boundaries on mount, restored by form reset. Defaults to the whole scale.

controls.name: clampToCrop
controls.description: Keeps the shown value inside the crop boundaries. Defaults to true.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key of the value, repeated once per thumb in ascending order.

controls.name: cropName
controls.description: FormData key of the crop boundaries, repeated for start and end while crop is on.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the controls, when it is not an ancestor.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Shows the required marker on the label; a range always has a value, so it never blocks submission.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the first thumb on mount.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared outer spacing around each thumb; toggling it keeps the DOM and focus. Defaults to true.
